product_changes: Per-worker ProgressPersistence actor with one ordered writer thread and bounded queue
Non-blocking SMPP response callback; Reader releases protocol Window before enqueue
Pre-dispatch reservation for one task terminal event plus one response event per encoded SMS part
Socket-written and response progress events moved off the asyncio event loop
Durable per-Campaign aggregate checkpoint with restart/rollover/reclaim replay
Crash-time partial JSONL tail repair before the first append
Low-frequency worker status heartbeat and explicit two-phase response/progress drain
Progress and transport observed/durable counters exposed in worker status
Thread-safe critical-path profiler counters for writer/heartbeat concurrency

focused_suites.scope: SMPP transport, worker, progress persistence, projection, runtime, E2E, CLI, static audit

limitations: SLES12SP5 native ext4 A/B (1K and paired 5K) was not available in this Windows workspace.
CLI OFF/ON paired overhead was not measured; only read-only and low-frequency properties were validated.
Per-Campaign projected counts are N/A and are reported in incomplete_metrics.
Durable campaign aggregates retain at most 256 campaigns; overflow evicts the oldest and marks statistics incomplete.
A process crash can still lose observed-but-not-fsynced events; these are reported as unresolved/crash gaps and never resent automatically.
50K, 600-second stability, real SMSC, production deployment and canary remain unauthorized/not run.
